# School marks

Decorative identification of the schools attended by the portfolio owner.

- UBC: https://cdn.ubc.ca/clf/7.0.5/img/ubc7-clf-sprite-blue-2x.png — crest region of the official web sprite, wrapped in an SVG viewport.
- UVic: https://www.uvic.ca/assets/core-4-0/img/shield-horz-white.svg — crest region of the official white signature, shown using an SVG viewport.
- NYIT: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ny_institute_technology_seal.svg — university seal, sourced from NYIT’s 2019 identity guidelines; the source page identifies it as PD-textlogo.

Artwork is not redrawn. CSS controls decorative opacity and display treatment.
